scenario: new Android Google Pay integration without prerequisites
prompt: We need to integrate Google Pay into our Android app. Create a plan.
expected: Loads or cites references/setup.md and/or references/implementation-playbook.md
Requires merchant/gateway prerequisites and environment separation before coding
Chooses an explicit tokenization mode (prefer PAYMENT_GATEWAY) and server-trusted totals
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-18: google-pay → references/setup.md + Path B in references/implementation-playbook.md; confirm merchant profile, package name, test vs prod, PAYMENT_GATEWAY vs DIRECT; keep amounts server-side; no raw token persistence.

scenario: web checkout failing at Google Pay button/auth
prompt: Our web Google Pay integration is failing when users check out. Please review.
expected: Asks for failure class evidence (merchant readiness, token processing, env mismatch, timeout, duplicate auth)
Forbids logging or chatting raw token payloads and checks idempotency/fallback
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-18: google-pay → references/failure-handling.md + references/validation-checklist.md; classify signature; verify merchant/env; no raw tokens in notes; confirm idempotency keys and fallback checkout.

scenario: user wants subscriptions powered only by Google Pay button
prompt: Can Google Pay alone handle our monthly subscriptions and failed-renewal dunning?
expected: States Google Pay is typically initial method capture; renewals/dunning belong to billing/subscriptions + PSP
Prefers or hands off to billing and/or subscriptions rather than inventing a Google-Pay-only renewer
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-18: google-pay → references/recurring-payments.md; initial capture via Google Pay, reusable method + renewals via PSP; handoff to billing/subscriptions (+ stripe-api-integration/paypal as needed).
